tips_en: Start with the SAFEACTBENCH paper (Paper 3)—its finding that agents can achieve >90% legacy accuracy while evidence-grounded correctness sits at 37–67% is a striking, broadly relevant result with immediate implications for deployed tool-using systems. The OPD paper (Paper 1) makes an excellent follow-up: both studies share a common methodological theme—commonly trusted metrics (endpoint accuracy, alignment coverage) can mask important failure modes—and Paper 1's negative result on span-MSE supervision complements Paper 3's negative finding on legacy evaluation. Read Paper 2 (TRACE) only if you specifically work on MoE RL training, as it is highly specialized compared to the other two.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 SAFEACTBENCH（论文 3）——其发现智能体在传统评估中可达到 90% 以上准确率，而基于证据的交互正确性却只有 37–67%，这是一个影响广泛且对实际部署系统具有直接启示的发现。接下来阅读 OPD 论文（论文 1）：两篇论文共享一个共同的方法论主题——常用的指标（端点准确率、对齐覆盖率）可能掩盖重要的失败模式，而论文 1 关于 span-MSE 监督的负面结果与论文 3 对传统评估的负面发现相互呼应。论文 2（TRACE）仅在你专门从事 MoE 强化学习训练工作时阅读，因为它比其他两篇更加专业化。
